summary: Creates a new Direct Issue document.
description:
Creates a new Direct Issue document. Line items are automatically expanded from available inventory locations based on the items specified in the request. When line_item_ids is sent, every Requirement line must have soft-allocated Quantity Available and acceptable stock at a location; otherwise the request is rejected with ZERO_QUANTITY listing those Requirement lines.
Send associated_requirement_id to associate a Final Requirement with the header without adding any lines yet; when line_item_ids is also sent, those lines must belong to that Requirement.

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.

line_item_ids.description:
Material Requirement line item IDs used to create a linked Direct Issue.
Mutually exclusive with Adapter.Api.Models.Request.Issuing.DirectIssueCreateRequest.ItemIds.

associated_requirement_id.description:
